python3 << 'PYEOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

configs = ['r16 α32\n(ratio=2)', 'r32 α32\n(ratio=1)', 'r32 α64\n(ratio=2)']
accs = [87.51, 87.0, 87.04]
colors = ['#2c3e50', '#7f8c8d', '#bdc3c7']
hatches = ['///', '...', '\\\\\\']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4))

bars = ax.bar(configs, accs, width=0.55, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
for bar, h in zip(bars, hatches):
    bar.set_hatch(h)

for bar, acc in zip(bars, accs):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.08,
            f'{acc:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

ax.axhline(y=87.51, color='#e74c3c', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=2, label='Baseline (r16 α32)')

ax.set_ylim(85.5, 88.5)
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=13)
ax.set_title('LoRA Rank Ablation on CWM 4B (Function-level)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=12)
ax.legend(fontsize=11, loc='upper right')
ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

for spine in ['top', 'right']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('artifacts/rank_ablation_chart.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('artifacts/rank_ablation_chart.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Charts saved.')
PYEOF
